note: Adapted from the original description of Silvestri 1914 (in Latin), published as Thoracotermes brevinotus sp. n., covering the queen, nymph, soldier and worker castes with measurements, and also recording the nest and inquiline habits; type locality Mamou, French Guinea. In the original the comma serves as the decimal point and has been transcribed here as 8.5 mm etc.; the printed value of the soldier hind tibia length is damaged in the scanned text as l1297822 and is omitted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The soldier pronotum is much shorter than in Th. macrothorax, the most conspicuous distinction of this species; the soldier head is almost rectangular, the labrum nearly rectangular with the anterior margin very briefly sub-triangular; the worker head is nearly circular, the clypeus strongly inflated, the antennae 15-segmented, and the head bears two reddish brown transverse bands that converge forwards.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Soldier: body ochre brown to rusty, mandibles black, abdomen more or less marked with black patches from the gut contents. Head about 1/4 longer than broad, thick and convex upwards to the fontanelle, the posterior corners broadly rounded, slightly narrowing anteriorly; labrum nearly rectangular, the anterior margin very briefly sub-triangular; mandibles nearly straight, tapering, the tips slightly curved, otherwise entire except for the basal tooth. Antennae 15 segments, segment 2 about 1/4 longer than segment 3, segment 4 about 1/4 longer than segment 3, segment 5 slightly shorter than segment 4. Pronotum measured in situ about 1/4 narrower than the head and about 1/4 broader than long, the anterior lobe rather high, the anterior margin slightly concave in the middle, the sides rounded, the posterior margin broad and slightly concave; mesonotum less than half as long as the pronotum. Fore coxa without spines; tibiae of all legs with short spine-like hairs and apical spines. Abdomen nearly bare. Measurements: body length 8.5 mm; head length 3 mm; head width 2.5 mm; antennal length 2.55 mm; mandible length 1.98 mm; pronotum width 2.08 mm (the printed value of the hind tibia length is damaged in the scan).

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Worker: body dirty milky white, head pale yellow, with two reddish brown transverse bands that converge forwards. Head nearly circular, clypeus strongly inflated; antennae 15 segments, segment 2 slightly more than twice as long as segment 3, segment 3 with only 1—2 outer hairs, segment 4 thicker and slightly longer than segment 3, segment 5 about 1/4 longer than segment 4. Fore coxa with several spine-like hairs anteriorly, internally and externally, trochanter with 5—6 spine-like hairs, femur with several spine-like hairs on the anterior inner margin, tibia with several spines and a stout inner apical spine near the apex of the inner margin, the outer apical spine smaller; mid and hind legs hairy, the tibiae with a stout inner apical spine. Measurements: body length 6 mm; head width 1.50 mm; antennal length 2.08 mm; hind tibia length 1.56 mm.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Queen: body length 30 mm, abdominal width 7 mm; head length 1.95 mm, width 1.56 mm; hind tibia length 2.5 mm. Nymph: body length 8.5 mm, wing buds 1.4 mm long, antennae 16 segments. Nest and inquilines: in an almost treeless waste near Mamou this species shares a nest with Eutermes suspensus; the nest surface is convex, 35 cm high and about 40 cm in basal diameter, made up of the cells and galleries of both termites, mostly those of this species; a queen was also collected in a rather large cell.
